about: The one source of the proxy settings per host. The tables in docs/install.md and docs/hosts.md are generated from it with `pnpm docs:hosts`, and posterna.com renders the quickstart snippets from it. The evidence for each row is in docs/hosts.md.

hosts.name: Railway, with or without Cloudflare in front
hosts.confidence: high: confirmed on a live site

hosts.name: Vercel
hosts.confidence: high: confirmed on a live site (IPv4)

hosts.name: Render
lines: trustedProxies: 3, // check with posterna doctor; use 2 if it reports a forged address
hosts.extra: `3` comes from a Render employee's demonstration, not Render's documentation ([Render](hosts.md#render)).

hosts.name: AWS Application Load Balancer
lines: trustedProxies: ["10.0.0.0/16"], // replace with your load balancer subnets' CIDRs
hosts.extra: The load balancer checks each target every 30 seconds by default, on `/`: [give health checks their own path](hosts.md#health-checks).

hosts.name: Amazon CloudFront, in front of any of these
hosts.clientAddress: the setting for the host behind it, plus CloudFront's ranges behind a load balancer; the origin request policy **AllViewerExceptHostHeader** is **required**

hosts.name: nginx on the same machine
hosts.clientAddress: `clientIpHeader: "x-real-ip"` and `trustedProxies: ["127.0.0.1/32", "::1/128"]`, with the nginx config below
hosts.extra: Bind Node to `127.0.0.1` and add [the `proxy_set_header` lines](hosts.md#nginx-in-front-of-node-on-the-same-machine) to nginx.

hosts.name: Any other host
lines: // Set clientIpHeader or trustedProxies for your host:
hosts.extra: Find your host's setting in [Hosts and proxies](hosts.md#settings-by-host).
